name: Elina Mäkinen
headline: MHSc  |  Health Informatics and Professional Agency
profile: Health informatics researcher interested in how clinicians keep professional autonomy when digital systems structure their work. My background combines eight years of nursing practice with qualitative field research and survey methods. My doctoral research interest is in when electronic health record design supports clinical judgement and when it pushes clinicians into workarounds.
researchInterests: Professional autonomy and agency in digitally mediated clinical work
Workarounds as signals of misfit between systems and practice
Design of electronic health records that supports clinical judgement

bullets: Examined why hospital nurses work around electronic health record workflows, framed through professional autonomy.
Interviewed 24 nurses and analysed the data with thematic analysis.
Found that workarounds protect professional autonomy, the theme my doctoral interest in clinicians' agency builds on.
